steps.counting: Intervals are numbered by counting note names, both ends included. From {c} to {e} you count {c}, {d}, {e}: three notes, so it’s a third. From {c} to {g} there are five: a fifth.
steps.staff: On the staff it’s quick to see: from a line to the next line, or from a space to the next space, is a third. From a line to the space beside it is a second.
steps.readStaff: Count up from the lower note, and choose.
steps.build: Count up from the note given, and find the note you land on, without sharps or flats.
steps.wider: Sixths, sevenths and the octave are counted the same way. An octave spans eight notes and lands on the same note name: {c} to {c}.
steps.allOfThem: All of them together. Only your first answer counts.
